title: Choose the Price
description: Inspection is not mastery. Use NightWalker's own Vampire Altar progression and acquire at least one choosable vampire power. If the Overlord already made that choice before Lestat reached this lesson, the real Nycto owner state will be recognized retrospectively.
description_completed: The Overlord has made at least one deliberate Vampire Altar power choice. Lestat's transition guidance is complete; deeper vampire progression remains NightWalker's own system rather than a Questlog imitation of it.

dialogue.offer: You have seen the menu. Now make a choice. Not because I prefer one trick to another, and certainly not because Gnarl has produced a table of efficiencies. Choose something you intend to use. Accept whatever weakness the altar demands. Then it will be yours rather than merely possible.
dialogue.in_progress: Still considering? Good. Impulse has its pleasures, but an Overlord can afford the luxury of intention.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: There it is. A choice made with open eyes. Much more becoming.
dialogue.completed: You know how to feed, where your powers are shaped, and that every appetite need not become a master. The rest is practice. I am not going anywhere merely because the first lesson is over.

prerequisites.name: Remain within the NightWalker vampire path

objectives.name: Acquire at least one choosable Vampire Altar power

rewards.name: Record completion of Lestat's transition guidance
